mainEntity.name: How long does a typical design-build project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a design-build project varies significantly based on its scope, complexity, and required permits. Small renovations might take a few months, while larger additions or whole-home remodels could extend beyond a year. Our integrated approach often shortens overall timelines compared to traditional methods by overlapping design and construction planning. During the initial consultation, we can provide a more specific timeline estimate based on your project details and local permitting requirements in your area, such as Union City or Hayward.
